title: Tracking Interviews - Job Tracker
description:
LIKE & SUBSCRIBE for you more Resume, Job Search & Career Growth content!

In this video, we're diving deep into the essential process of managing your job interviews!  From tracking your interview dates to organizing your contacts, we'll equip you with all the tools needed to navigate the interview stage like a pro. 

What We Will Cover:
- How to manage your interview process effectively 
- Setting and tracking interview dates and times 
- Recording the type of interview (phone, video, panel) 
- Researching your interviewers and saving their contacts 
- Organizing your job search for maximum efficiency 
- How to close jobs and track your progress through stages 

Questions Answered in This Video:
- How do I set my interview date and time?
- What information should I track during my interviews?
- How can I find out who I'm interviewing with?
- What should I do if I need to close a job application?
- How can I keep my job search organized and effective?
